findings.claim: The supplied review material must provide complete visibility of the goal-relevant OpenAPI contract and focused contract test before semantic acceptance can be established.
findings.observed: The caller-computed visibility contract has complete=false; be-document-processing/contracts/openapi-processing-monitor.yaml is partial and be-document-processing/tests/test_monitor_openapi_observation_contract.py is omitted.
findings.rationale: The unseen remainder can materially affect YAML validity, local-reference resolution, exact DTO allowlists, lifecycle schemas, and the focused assertions. The contract explicitly forbids inferring completeness or implementation absence from this truncated evidence.
findings.required: Provide a complete caller-supplied diff or equivalent complete goal-relevant artifacts for the OpenAPI YAML and focused contract test, then perform a new acceptance run without treating omitted content as absent implementation.

goals.summary: Monitoring OpenAPI: opravit YAML a dokončit přesné observation DTO kontrakty
